name: Kindle Whisper
d: You command a flame you can see to dance, flare up, or gutter out. You can also make the fire lash out and burn a creature near it.

name: Umbral Lance
d: You hurl a spear of living shadow at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the shadow pierces it with frost-dark cold.

name: Rimebloom
d: Ice crystals bloom at a point you choose and shatter outward in a ring of razor frost. Each creature caught in the burst must make a Dexterity save or take cold damage.

name: Glare of the Sunken Eye
d: Your eyes flash with drowned starlight at a creature that meets your gaze. It must make a Constitution save or be blinded until your next turn.

name: Mote Volley
d: You flick a swarm of humming star-motes at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, the motes strike it with force.

name: Cinderveil Flash
d: White fire flares in a crown around you. Each creature nearby must make a Constitution save or be dazzled and blinded until your next turn.

name: Hallucinate
d: A small, silent illusion shimmers into being, real enough to fool a passing glance.

name: Hearthseed
d: You conjure a steady, smokeless flame in your palm. It gives off light and warmth and can be used to light things, but doesn't burn you.

name: Rootgrip
d: Roots erupt beneath a creature and wrap around its legs. It must make a Strength save or be held in place.

name: Bend Water
d: You beckon nearby water to rise, part, or swirl at the flick of your hand.

name: Hex of Whispers
d: You whisper a curse in a dead tongue at a creature. It must make a Wisdom save or take psychic damage as the words sap its nerve.

name: Wisp of the Pale Star
d: You call a mote of starlight that hovers where you point and lights the area around it.

name: Stormcall
d: Lightning crawls over your hand, and whatever you touch is jolted by a crackling thunderbolt.

name: Stillfrost Grasp
d: Your touch encases a creature or object in hoarfrost. A creature must make a Constitution save or be frozen in place for a moment.

name: Tempo Shift
d: You bend time around a creature, either speeding up an ally or slowing down a foe. An unwilling target makes a Wisdom save to resist.

name: Emberwing
d: A sparrow made of embers bursts from your sleeve and dives at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it explodes in fire.

name: Winter's Kiss
d: You blow a kiss of winter at a creature. It must make a Constitution save or take cold damage and have its speed reduced.

name: Greenwhisper
d: You listen to the plants around you, and they tell you what has passed among them in the last day.

name: Lanternmoth
d: A moth of golden light flutters from your hands and follows you, shining like a lantern.

name: Bend Stone
d: Under your palms, solid stone softens like clay and takes whatever form you press into it.

name: Ride the Wind
d: A gust lifts you off your feet and sets you down gently anywhere within 30 feet.

name: Venomsip
d: You draw poison out of a creature's wound and flick it away harmlessly, ending the poison's effect.

name: Echo of the Unseen
d: You send a whisper through the air that returns to tell you what is waiting on the other side of a door or wall.

name: Briarchain
d: Thorned vines lash out of the ground and wrap around a creature. It must make a Strength save or be restrained and take piercing damage from the thorns.

name: Phoenix Fan
d: You sweep your arm and send out a cone of burning phoenix feathers. Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity save, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Mistwalk Veil
d: A silver mist rises around you and blurs your form. Attacks against you are made at disadvantage.

name: Ironblood Oath
d: You mark an ally with your blood, steadying their arms. Their weapon attacks become more accurate.

name: Babel Kiss
d: You touch a creature's lips, letting it speak and understand every language it hears.

name: Starward Ward
d: A lattice of starlight surrounds you. The next attack that hits you is turned aside harmlessly.

name: Ashen Path
d: You leave a trail of glowing ash footprints that only you and allies you choose can see.

name: Thunderneedle
d: You fire a needle of lightning at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it punches through armor and deals lightning damage.

name: Mountain's Root
d: Your feet root into the ground like a mountain. Nothing can push, pull, or knock you prone.

name: Mirrorflash
d: You flash conjured light from a silver mirror at a creature. It must make a Constitution save or be blinded.

name: Bloodread
d: You taste a drop of a creature's blood and learn about it: how wounded it is, what it fears, and what it last ate.

name: Gale Avenue
d: A corridor of roaring wind blasts out in a line. Each creature in the line must make a Strength save or be hurled along its path.

name: Choir of Iron
d: You sing, and your allies' weapons ring in answer. While your song lasts, their weapon attacks deal extra damage.

name: Starless Night
d: You fill an area with magical, moonless darkness that ordinary light can't penetrate.

name: Tectonic Pulse
d: The earth heaves and splits beneath your enemies. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity save, taking bludgeoning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Sunspear
d: You call down a lance of sunlight on a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it takes radiant damage, and undead are hit especially hard.

name: Moonpull Tide
d: You command the tides to drag a creature. It must make a Strength save or be pulled wherever you choose.

name: Mind Palace
d: You build a palace of thought in your mind, sharpening your focus. The next spell you cast costs less to cast.

name: Wildfire Chain
d: Fire leaps from foe to foe like a living thing. Each creature it reaches must make a Dexterity save, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Diamond Skin
d: You turn an ally's skin to living diamond, making them much harder to hit and letting blades glance off.

name: Skyhammer
d: You call down a pillar of lightning on a point you choose. Each creature there must make a Dexterity save, taking lightning damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Choir of the Hollow
d: Ghostly voices sing from nowhere. Each enemy that hears them must make a Wisdom save or become confused and lose its way.

name: Dome of Dawn
d: A dome of golden dawnlight covers your allies, healing their wounds and protecting them from dark magic while they stay inside.

name: Riftwalk
d: You tear open space and step through to any place you have seen with your own eyes.

name: Winter's Throne
d: You call down a raging blizzard over an area. Each creature caught in it must make a Constitution save, taking cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Glass Heart
d: You read a creature's heart as if it were glass. It must make a Wisdom save or reveal its true emotions and intentions to you.

name: Starfall Barrage
d: You pull down a storm of falling stars across the battlefield. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity save, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Loom of Silence
d: You create a zone of total silence. No sound can be made inside it, and spells that need a voice can't be cast there.

name: Loom of the World
d: You pull the threads of reality and restore a broken structure, like a bridge, wall, or ruin, as if it were new.

name: Blackened Sun
d: You brand a creature with an eclipse. It must make a Charisma save or burn with sunlight and freeze with shadow, taking damage at the start of each of its turns.

name: Skysunder
d: You split the sky and drop a line of raw force from the heavens. Each creature in the line must make a Dexterity save, taking force damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Covenant of Eternal Dawn
d: You call down the first dawn of creation on your allies. They are blessed, and they can't be killed while the spell lasts.

name: Door Beyond the Stars
d: You open a doorway to another plane of existence. You and your allies can step through to any world you name.

name: Flame Lash
d: A whip of liquid fire uncoils from your hand and lashes a creature. Make a melee spell attack; on a hit, it takes fire damage.

name: Glacial Dart
d: You hurl a shard of glacier ice at a creature. Make a ranged spell attack; on a hit, it takes cold damage.

name: Oak's Watch
d: You touch a tree and borrow its senses, letting you see and hear everything that passes beneath its branches.

name: Stonewright's Touch
d: You soften stone with your touch so you can sculpt it with your fingers like clay.

name: Rainspoon
d: You draw a cup of glowing rain from the air. A creature that drinks it regains a small amount of health.

name: Heartbeat Theft
d: You steal a heartbeat from time and act a moment sooner, improving your place in the initiative order.

name: Bloodsight
d: Your eyes turn crimson and you can see the heartbeat of every living creature nearby, even through walls.

name: Breath of the Deep
d: You fill a creature's lungs with enchanted air, letting it breathe underwater or in thick smoke.

name: Emberbind
d: Ropes of smoldering ash coil around a creature's feet. It must make a Dexterity save or take fire damage and have its speed reduced.

name: Glacierwall
d: A wall of blue ice bursts from the ground, giving you cover and blocking attacks from the other side.

name: Thorngate
d: You seal a doorway with a lattice of living thorns. Any creature that forces its way through takes piercing damage.

name: Groundsplit
d: You stamp and the ground cracks open under a creature. It must make a Dexterity save or take bludgeoning damage and fall prone.

name: Undertow
d: A phantom tide surges around a creature. It must make a Strength save or be dragged toward you.

name: Witherbrand
d: You burn a rotting sigil into a creature's flesh. It must make a Constitution save or take necrotic damage and be unable to regain health until your next turn.

name: Beacon
d: A tiny star falls and clings to a creature, outlining it in light so it cannot hide.

name: Skyshift
d: You fold the air and step through it, teleporting to a spot you can see within range.

name: Nightfold
d: You fold the shadows around an area into a pocket of silent, magical darkness.

name: Viper's Kiss
d: Venom wells from your fingertips as you touch a creature. It must make a Constitution save, taking poison damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Ghostward Hush
d: You quiet the restless dead around you. Spirits and undead in the area can't harm the living while the spell lasts.

name: Stormthread
d: You catch a bolt of lightning on your fingertip and redirect it, turning an incoming lightning attack or spell toward a target you choose.

name: Pyre Halo
d: A halo of fire crowns an ally. Any creature that hits or grabs them takes fire damage.

name: Frozen Moment
d: You freeze a moment in time around a creature. It must make a Wisdom save or be paralyzed, unable to move or act.

name: Verdant Uprising
d: A forest erupts from the ground, and its branches grab at everything nearby. Each creature in the area must make a Strength save or be restrained.

name: Obelisk of Wrath
d: A black obelisk thrusts up from the ground beneath a creature. It must make a Strength save or take bludgeoning damage and be thrown into the air.

name: Drowned Dream
d: You fill a creature's mind with the feeling of drowning. It must make a Wisdom save or be incapacitated as it struggles for air.

name: Echo of Yesterday
d: You replay the last minute of time around you like a ghostly echo, letting you see what just happened in the area.

name: Soulthread
d: You link the minds of willing allies with an astral thread so they can share thoughts telepathically.

name: Bloodward
d: You paint a ward in your own blood. It absorbs the next harmful spell aimed at you.

name: Rot Hymn
d: You sing a song of decay, and wood, rope, and flesh around you rot away. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution save, taking necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Rolling Thunder
d: You split the sky along a line, and a roll of thunder crashes down upon everything in its path.

name: Phoenix Rebirth
d: Flames consume a dying ally, and they rise from the ashes healed and cured of poison and disease.

name: Orbit of the Lost Moon
d: A small moon of astral light circles you and blocks the first attack against you each round.

name: Bonegarden
d: Skeletal hands burst out of the ground in an area and drag at your foes. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution save, taking necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: King of Tides
d: The sea rises at your command. Each creature in it must make a Strength save or be forced to its knees.

name: Hourglass Prison
d: You trap a creature in a prison of slowed time. It must make a Wisdom save or be stuck, barely able to move or act.

name: Tribunal of Souls
d: The spirits of ancient judges stand beside your allies, protecting them from being frightened or charmed.

name: Star Mark
d: You brand a foe with the mark of a comet, and the next strike against it calls a falling star down upon it.

name: Living Cathedral
d: You reshape an ally's body into a fortress, greatly boosting their health and toughness.

name: Soulswap
d: You rip two creatures' souls out of their bodies and swap them. Each must make a Charisma save or wake up trapped in the other's body.

name: Pyre of Worlds
d: A column of fire erupts at a point you choose. Each creature in it must make a Dexterity save, taking fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Static Bloom
d: A burst of sparks blooms at a point you choose. Each creature nearby must make a Dexterity save or take lightning damage.

name: Rime Seal
d: You breathe on a lock, jar, or door and freeze it shut under a sheet of magic ice.

name: Verdant Hand
d: A hand of woven vines grows from the ground to fetch, carry, or pull things for you.

name: Grit Storm
d: You kick up a whirling cloud of grit. Each creature inside must make a Constitution save or be blinded.

name: Water Mark
d: You brand a creature with a sigil of the sea, and each turn the tide hauls it toward you.

name: Painecho
d: You force a creature to relive its oldest wound. It must make a Wisdom save, taking psychic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Astral Sidestep
d: You slip half a step into the astral sea, letting an attack pass harmlessly through you.

name: Unwind
d: You rewind a moment for an ally, letting them reroll an attack, check, or save they just failed.

name: Wraithbond
d: You bind a wandering spirit to your will. It must make a Charisma save or be forced to answer your questions truthfully.

name: Heartsight
d: You see every heart within range glowing through flesh, and you know how close each creature is to death.

name: Titan's Sinew
d: An ally swells with a giant's strength, letting them lift, carry, and hit much harder.

name: Razorwind
d: A blade-sharp sheet of wind sweeps across an area. Each creature in it must make a Dexterity save, taking slashing damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Deepquake
d: A buried boom shakes the earth from below, deafening and toppling everything above it.

name: Inkfall Eclipse
d: You blot out the sun over an area and fill it with liquid darkness that ordinary light can't penetrate.

name: Starfall Snare
d: A loop of falling stars wraps around a creature. It must make a Dexterity save or be restrained and held in midair.

name: Serpent's Draught
d: You coat your weapon in serpent venom. The next creature you hit must make a Constitution save or take poison damage.

name: Withering Tithe
d: You drain the life from everything around you, withering plants and foes alike. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution save, taking necrotic damage on a failure or half as much on a success.

name: Hearthwyrm
d: You summon a wyrm of living fire that coils at your side. On your turn, it breathes flame at your foes, who must make a Dexterity save or take fire damage.

name: Stillwater Peace
d: Your voice calms everything around you. Creatures in the area must make a Charisma save or have their hostility quieted.

name: Sealbreaker
d: You speak a word of unmaking that shatters magical seals, locks, and wards in front of you.

name: Caustic Bolt
d: A shimmering green bolt streaks toward a foe and bursts in a hissing spray of acid.

name: Corrosive Spatter
d: A bead of hissing green acid flies from your fingers and splashes across your foes.

name: Rallying Light
d: Golden warmth fills your allies, bolstering their spirit and stamina.

name: Tripwire Ward
d: An invisible ward hums across a doorway or camp, waking you when anything crosses it.

name: Fleshshift
d: Your body reshapes itself to blend in, breathe water, or grow claws.

name: Beastcalm
d: You speak soothingly to a wild creature, and it comes to see you as a friend.

name: Wingborne Message
d: A small beast carries your message swiftly to a distant friend.

name: Pack Forms
d: Your allies take the forms of beasts.

name: Raise Bones
d: Bones and corpses stir and rise to serve you.

name: Waking Things
d: Objects come to life and fight for you.

name: Lifeward Shell
d: A barrier repels living creatures from you.

name: Null Field
d: A sphere where no magic can function.

name: Lure and Repel
d: An object draws or repels a kind of creature.

name: Scout's Orb
d: An invisible floating eye lets you scout far ahead.

name: Force Fist
d: A giant hand of force appears to grasp, push, or crush.

name: Runelock
d: A rune-bound lock seals a door or chest, holding fast against intruders.

name: Phantom Blade
d: A shimmering spectral sword fights at your command.

name: Masking Veil
d: You mask an object's or creature's magic so it reads as something else.

name: Starwalk
d: Your spirit leaves your body to wander the planes.

name: Omen Reading
d: You cast signs and stones to glimpse whether a path leads to fortune or woe.

name: Awakening
d: A beast or plant gains a mind of its own.

name: Ill Fortune
d: A pall of bad luck settles over your enemies, making every effort falter.

name: Exile
d: A creature vanishes to a distant plane, banished from your sight.

name: Root Armor
d: Your skin turns rough and hard as old tree bark.

name: Hopeflare
d: A beacon of hope fills your allies with faith and vitality.

name: Hexcurse
d: A dark curse weakens a creature in a way of your choosing.

name: Abyssal Grasp
d: Writhing black tendrils rise to clutch and crush.

name: Bladestorm Wall
d: A whirling wall of spectral blades shreds anything that passes.

name: Blessing
d: A warm glow settles on your allies, guiding their blows and steadying their nerve.

name: Blightdraw
d: Life drains from a creature or plant, leaving it shriveled.

name: Senseblight
d: You steal a creature's sight or hearing with a curse.

name: Flicker Step
d: You flicker in and out of the spirit realm, hard to pin down.

name: Shimmerblur
d: Your form wavers and blurs, making you hard to strike.

name: Searing Brand
d: Your weapon flares with radiant light, branding a foe so it cannot hide.

name: Flame Fan
d: Fire sprays from your spread fingers in a roaring sheet.

name: Thunderhead
d: A storm cloud gathers overhead, ready to hurl lightning at your command.

name: Hush of Peace
d: A wave of peace washes over creatures, soothing rage and fear.

name: Arc Bolt
d: Lightning leaps from foe to foe in a crackling arc.

name: Warm Regard
d: A creature suddenly sees you as a trusted friend, at least for a while.

name: Gravegrip
d: A spectral, bone-cold hand clutches a foe and drains the warmth of life from it.

name: Deathring
d: A sphere of negative energy ripples outward, draining life.

name: Farsight
d: An invisible sensor lets you see or hear a distant, familiar place.

name: Twin Vessel
d: A clone waits to receive your soul upon death.

name: Death Fog
d: A rolling, poisonous fog drifts from you to choke your foes.

name: Prism Burst
d: A dazzling spray of colored light leaves those in its path reeling and blind.

name: Commanding Word
d: You speak a single word laced with power, and a creature obeys.

name: Higher Counsel
d: You ask divine powers a few questions and receive answers.

name: Landspeak
d: The land itself tells you of its secrets.

name: Tongue Sense
d: Strange words and foreign letters unravel into meaning before your eyes and ears.

name: Compelling Pull
d: Creatures are compelled to move where you will them.

name: Winter Gust
d: A blast of bitter cold erupts from your hands.

name: Bewilder
d: Minds twist and stumble, leaving creatures confused.

name: Beastcall
d: Spirits of wild animals take form to fight at your side.

name: Heavenly Summons
d: A celestial being answers your call.

name: Primal Summons
d: A great elemental is summoned to serve you.

name: Feycall
d: A fey creature answers your summons.

name: Elemental Swarm
d: Small elemental spirits take form to serve you.

name: Wildwood Call
d: Fey spirits of the forest appear to serve you.

name: Voidtouch Query
d: Your mind brushes alien powers for answers, at a risk.

name: Plaguetouch
d: Your touch spreads a vile, lingering sickness.

name: Trigger Spell
d: You set a spell to fire when a condition is met.

name: Everflame
d: A flame that gives no heat burns forever on an object you touch.

name: Skyweaving
d: You bend the weather to your will.

name: Spellbreak
d: You snuff out another caster's magic in the moment it's woven.

name: Provender
d: Simple food and fresh water appear to feed a weary group.

name: Wellspring
d: Clean water pours from nowhere, or a pool of water vanishes into mist.

name: Raise Unliving
d: Corpses rise as strong, undead servants.

name: Shadowmake
d: You shape an object from the stuff of shadow.

name: Warm Hands
d: Your touch closes wounds and eases pain with soft, warm light.

name: Wisplights
d: Tiny floating lanterns of soft light bob and drift wherever you guide them.

name: Blackveil
d: Magical darkness spreads from a point, swallowing all light.

name: Nightsight
d: Your eyes adjust to see through darkness as if it were dim light.

name: Noonlight
d: A sphere of bright sunlight bursts into being and banishes the dark.

name: Grave Denial
d: A creature is protected from falling to death's touch.

name: Fused Ember
d: A bead of fire grows hotter the longer it waits.

name: Pocket Realm
d: A door opens to a small hidden realm.

name: Spirit Sense
d: You feel the presence of otherworldly beings, holy or unholy, lurking nearby.

name: Magesight
d: The glow of nearby magic becomes visible to you like faint auras in the air.

name: Blight Sense
d: You sense sickness and poison, seeing them as a faint, sour shimmer.

name: Thoughtread
d: You hear the surface thoughts of creatures around you.

name: Far Door
d: A shimmering door lets you step a long distance in an instant.

name: False Face
d: Your appearance shifts like a mask, changing your face, clothes, and form.

name: Unmaking Ray
d: A thin green ray reduces its target to dust.

name: Banish Ward
d: You drive otherworldly beings back to their home.

name: Unweave
d: You unravel an ongoing spell, ending its magic.

name: Oracle's Answer
d: A truthful answer comes from beyond to a question you ask.

name: Zealous Strike
d: Your weapon glows with fervor, each blow searing with radiant power.

name: Word of Heaven
d: A word of divine power strikes down the unworthy.

name: Beastbind
d: You seize control of a beast's mind.

name: Will Seize
d: You seize control of any creature's mind.

name: Mindbind
d: You seize control of a humanoid's mind.

name: Dreamwalk
d: You walk into a creature's dreams to speak or terrify.

name: Wildsign
d: You read the wind for weather, coax a bud to bloom, or stir the leaves with a whisper of the wild.

name: Worldshake
d: The ground heaves and splits in a mighty quake.

name: Void Lance
d: A crackling beam of raw otherworldly force tears out from your outstretched hand.

name: Inner Gift
d: A creature is gifted with the strength, grace, or wits of a beast.

name: Grow or Shrink
d: A creature or object swells to giant size or dwindles to tiny proportions.

name: Grasping Vines
d: Weeds and vines burst from the ground, coiling around anything nearby.

name: Captivate
d: Your words weave a spell that holds an audience in rapt attention.

name: Spiritwalk
d: You step into the spirit realm, unseen by the living.

name: Swiftfoot
d: Your legs blur with speed, letting you dash away in the blink of an eye.

name: Hex Gaze
d: Your eyes become dark, casting curses with each glance.

name: Swift Craft
d: Raw materials reshape themselves into finished goods.

name: Glowmark
d: Shimmering light outlines your foes, leaving them nowhere to hide.

name: Ghost Sentry
d: An invisible guardian hound keeps watch for you.

name: Deathless Vigor
d: Necromantic power bolsters you with a borrowed, hollow vitality.

name: Terror Wave
d: A wave of dread sends creatures fleeing in panic.

name: Downy Descent
d: Falling creatures slow to a gentle drift, landing as light as feathers.

name: Mindbreak
d: A creature's mind shatters, leaving it dull.

name: Spirit Companion
d: A spirit answers your call and takes the shape of a small, loyal animal.

name: Spirit Mount
d: A loyal, intelligent steed answers your call to serve you.

name: Wayfinding
d: You know the path to any place you seek.

name: Snare Sense
d: You sense hidden traps and dangers nearby.

name: Deathpoint
d: Your finger points, and dark energy rips away life.

name: Cinder Dart
d: A mote of fire leaps from your fingertip and bursts against your target.

name: Flame Mantle
d: A mantle of fire or frost wraps your body and burns attackers.

name: Blazing Tempest
d: A raging storm of fire sweeps the area.

name: Ember Burst
d: A bead of fire streaks to a point and erupts in a roaring blossom of flame.

name: Fire Sword
d: A blade of searing flame ignites in your hand.

name: Pillar of Flame
d: A column of fire and radiance falls from the heavens.

name: Rolling Blaze
d: A burning sphere of fire rolls across the field at your command.

name: Stoneflesh
d: A creature's flesh slowly hardens into stone.

name: Hover Platform
d: A flat, floating disk of force appears to carry your burdens behind you.

name: Skyrise
d: A creature rises off the ground and soars through the air.

name: Mistcloak
d: A thick bank of fog rolls out from a point you choose, swallowing sight.

name: Forbidden Ground
d: You ward an area against teleportation and outsiders.

name: Prism Cage
d: An invisible cage of force traps a creature.

name: Fatesight
d: You see moments into the future.

name: Unbound Stride
d: A creature moves freely, unhindered by bonds or grasping magic.

name: Frost Orb
d: A frigid globe explodes, freezing anything it touches.

name: Mistform
d: A creature dissolves into a drifting cloud of mist.

name: Worldgate
d: A portal opens between worlds.

name: Binding Oath
d: A magical command compels a creature to perform a service.

name: Death Rest
d: You preserve a corpse from decay and from being raised against its will.

name: Swollen Vermin
d: Insects swell into giant creatures under your command.

name: Silver Tongue
d: Your words ring true, even when false.

name: Spellglobe
d: A shimmering barrier blocks lesser magic.

name: Waiting Sigil
d: A hidden glyph waits to unleash magic on whoever triggers it.

name: Hearthberries
d: A handful of berries glows with magic, each one as filling as a meal.

name: Slickfloor
d: A slick, greasy film spreads across the ground, sending foes tumbling.

name: Deep Vanish
d: You vanish completely, even while you strike.

name: Deep Cleansing
d: Your touch lifts a creature's deepest curses and afflictions.

name: Sentinel Spirit
d: A spectral guardian appears to watch over a place.

name: Keepward
d: Wards protect a stronghold against intruders.

name: Steady Hand
d: A gentle touch steadies an ally's focus just when they need it most.

name: Starlance
d: A flash of starlight streaks toward a foe and leaves it glowing for your allies.

name: Gale Burst
d: A strong wind howls out from you, pushing back all in its path.

name: Sanctify
d: You consecrate an area with lasting protective power.

name: Land Glamour
d: The land itself seems to change shape and form.

name: Ruin
d: A creature is wracked by a wave of virulent disease.

name: Quickening
d: A creature moves with blinding speed and extra vigor.

name: Lifebloom
d: A surge of healing energy restores a creature's vitality.

name: Kind Word
d: A single kind word mends an ally's wounds from across the battlefield.

name: Red Iron
d: Metal glows red-hot, searing whoever holds or wears it.

name: Infernal Retort
d: When struck, you answer with a burst of infernal flame that engulfs your attacker.

name: Grand Feast
d: A magical feast fortifies all who share it.

name: Valor
d: Courage floods a creature, steeling it against fear and bolstering its spirit.

name: Giggle Curse
d: A creature collapses in helpless laughter at a joke only it can hear.

name: Creature Lock
d: A creature of any kind freezes in place.

name: Body Lock
d: A humanoid freezes in place, its muscles locked by your magic.

name: Radiant Halo
d: Divine light protects your allies.

name: Prey Brand
d: You mark your prey with a hunter's magic, sensing its every move.

name: Mesmer Weave
d: A twisting pattern of colors leaves watchers transfixed.

name: Hailstorm
d: Hail and ice rain down in a crushing storm.

name: Lore Touch
d: You learn an object's secrets and magic by holding it in your hands.

name: Secret Ink
d: Your writing hides its true message, readable only by those you choose.

name: Eternal Prison
d: A creature is bound in an eternal prison.

name: Ashen Smother
d: A cloud of burning smoke rolls across the field.

name: Rotting Touch
d: Your touch spreads rot and ruin through a foe's flesh.

name: Swarmcloud
d: A buzzing, biting swarm of insects fills an area.

name: Recall Mark
d: You summon a marked object straight into your hand.

name: Vanish
d: You or another slip from sight entirely, unseen by any eye.

name: Compel Dance
d: A creature dances wildly, unable to stop.

name: Springstep
d: Your legs coil with magic, letting you leap great distances.

name: Unbar
d: Locks click open and bars slide back with a ringing knock.

name: Lorecall
d: You learn the legends and lore of a person, place, or thing.

name: Purge Ailment
d: Your touch cures a creature of disease, poison, or a crippling condition.

name: Drift Rise
d: A creature or object rises slowly into the air and hangs there.

name: Lanternkiss
d: You touch an object and it glows with a warm, steady light like a hearth lantern.

name: Thunderspear
d: A stroke of lightning blasts out in a straight line.

name: Wild Seeking
d: You sense the nearest wild creature or plant of a kind you name.

name: Kin Seeking
d: You sense the direction of a creature you know.

name: Lost and Found
d: You feel the pull of an object you're seeking, guiding you toward it.

name: Far Stride
d: Your steps lengthen and quicken for the long road ahead.

name: Spell Ward
d: A shimmering layer of magic surrounds you like invisible armor.

name: Phantom Grasp
d: A faint spectral hand appears to lift, pull, and carry things at your direction.

name: Rune Ring
d: A circle of runes binds or bars a kind of creature.

name: Soul Vessel
d: Your soul leaves your body and dwells in an object.

name: Seeker Darts
d: Glowing darts of force streak from your hand and never miss their mark.

name: Speaking Sigil
d: An object speaks a message you leave when a condition you set is met.

name: Rune Edge
d: A weapon glows with runes that make it strike truer and harder.

name: Hidden Manor
d: A grand mansion awaits behind a shimmering door.

name: Grand Illusion
d: A vivid, moving illusion fills the scene with sight, sound, and smell.

name: Tide of Mending
d: Healing light washes over many allies at once.

name: Great Mending
d: Healing energy restores many creatures at once.

name: Rallying Hymn
d: Your voice rings out and mends the wounds of many allies at once.

name: Crowd Urging
d: Your words plant ideas in many minds at once.

name: Labyrinth
d: A creature is lost in a twisting maze.

name: Stonemerge
d: You step into stone and become one with it, hidden from sight.

name: Seamknit
d: Broken things knit back together under your touch, leaving no scar or seam.

name: Windborne Word
d: Your whisper rides the air to a distant ear, and their reply finds its way back to you.

name: Skyfire Rain
d: Blazing stars fall from the sky in fiery impacts.

name: Mindveil
d: Your mind is shielded from all intrusion.

name: Dreamscape
d: The land itself shifts to a convincing illusion.

name: Twin Phantoms
d: Illusory duplicates of you appear, confusing foes about where you stand.

name: Decoy Self
d: You turn invisible as an illusory double takes your place.

name: Mist Hop
d: You vanish in a puff of silver mist and reappear a short distance away.

name: Memory Weave
d: You reshape a creature's memories of an event.

name: Moonray
d: A silver beam of pale moonlight burns down on those beneath it.

name: Earthshift
d: The earth itself reshapes at your command.

name: Scryshroud
d: You hide a creature or object from magical prying eyes.

name: Trackless Path
d: Shadow and silence cloak your group, leaving no trace of your passage.

name: Wall Walk
d: A passage opens through solid walls and stone.

name: Nightmare Shade
d: A creature's worst fear takes shape in its mind.

name: Dusk Charger
d: A swift, quasi-real horse appears to carry you.

name: Otherworld Aid
d: An otherworldly being answers your call for aid.

name: Otherworld Leash
d: You bind a summoned creature to serve you.

name: Worldshift
d: You and your allies travel to another plane.

name: Overgrowth
d: Plants burst into lush growth, either choking the land or enriching it.

name: Venom Mist
d: A puff of sickly green vapor bursts from your palm and chokes the air around a foe.

name: Beastshape
d: A creature transforms into a beast.

name: Deathword
d: A single word ends a creature's life.

name: Stunning Utterance
d: A single word stuns a creature.

name: Fireside Chant
d: A quiet chant spreads soothing warmth through your gathered allies.

name: Hedge Trick
d: Small, harmless wonders bloom at your fingertips: sparks, scents, chills, and tidied dust.

name: Rainbow Ray
d: Rays of many colors burst out, each with a different effect.

name: Rainbow Barrier
d: A shimmering wall of many colors blocks all.

name: Warded Haven
d: A room is warded against prying eyes and magic.

name: Palm Ember
d: A flickering flame blooms in your open hand, ready to light the dark or be hurled.

name: Timed Mirage
d: An illusion springs to life when its trigger occurs.

name: Shadow Self
d: An illusory copy of you appears far away.

name: Elemental Ward
d: A creature is shielded against the fury of fire, frost, acid, lightning, or thunder.

name: Otherworld Ward
d: A protective aura guards a creature from beings beyond the mortal world.

name: Venomward
d: You cleanse a creature of poison and shield it against toxins.

name: Cleanse Provisions
d: Spoiled food and fouled water turn fresh and safe again.

name: Return Call
d: You return a dead creature to life.

name: Sapping Beam
d: A dark ray saps a creature's strength, weakening its blows.

name: Frostline
d: A pale blue ray of bitter cold lances out and slows whatever it touches.

name: Regrowth
d: Lost limbs and wounds regrow over time.

name: Rebirth
d: A dead creature returns to life in a new body.

name: Hexbreaker
d: You break the curses that bind a creature or object.

name: Force Bubble
d: A shimmering sphere of force traps a creature or shields it.

name: Warding Touch
d: A brief touch leaves an ally wrapped in a faint shield against harm.

name: Long Return
d: A creature long dead returns to life.

name: Skyfall Reversal
d: Gravity flips, hurling creatures upward.

name: Second Breath
d: You call a freshly fallen creature back to life before death takes hold.

name: Hidden Loft

name: Dawnfall
d: Pure radiance pours down on a foe like the first light breaking through the clouds.

name: Hallowed Refuge
d: A creature is shielded by quiet grace that turns attackers aside.

name: Flame Rays
d: Searing beams of fire streak from your hands toward your foes.

name: Seeing Pool
d: You spy on a creature from afar through a sensor.

name: Hidden Coffer
d: A chest is hidden away in another plane for later recall.

name: Unseen Sight
d: Your eyes pierce invisibility and glimpse things hiding between worlds.

name: Glamour Masks
d: Creatures take on new appearances of your design.

name: Distant Word
d: Your brief message crosses any distance to a creature you know.

name: Deep Hiding
d: A creature or object is hidden away from all sight.

name: Shapeshift
d: You take the form of any creature.

name: Resonant Burst
d: A piercing ring of sound shatters stone and glass.

name: Force Aegis
d: An invisible barrier snaps into place to deflect a blow at the last moment.

name: Faithguard
d: A shimmering field surrounds an ally and turns aside harm.

name: Oakheart Cudgel
d: Your staff or club swells with the strength of old oak and strikes with nature's weight.

name: Spark Grip
d: Lightning crackles across your hand and jolts whoever you touch.

name: Hushdome
d: A dome of total silence swallows all sound within it.

name: Still Mirage
d: You conjure a silent, motionless illusion of anything you can picture.

name: Snow Double
d: A duplicate of a creature forms from snow and ice.

name: Slumber Mist
d: A drowsy haze rolls over creatures, sending them into a deep sleep.

name: Icestorm Squall
d: Freezing rain and sleet lash an area, blinding and tripping.

name: Leaden Time
d: Time thickens around your foes, slowing their every move.

name: Last Breath
d: You steady a dying creature, holding its fading life in place.

name: Beastspeech
d: You understand the voices of animals and can speak with them in turn.

name: Waking the Dead
d: A corpse rasps out answers to your questions.

name: Rootspeech
d: Plants share what they have seen and bend to your requests.

name: Defy Gravity
d: A creature clings to walls and ceilings like a spider.

name: Rose Garden
d: The ground sprouts hidden thorns and spikes that tear at anyone who crosses it.

name: Spirit Ring
d: Spirits swirl around you, harming foes who come near.

name: Spectral Blade
d: A floating, ghostly weapon appears to strike at your command.

name: Stink Bomb
d: A nauseating cloud of fumes leaves creatures retching.

name: Graniteskin
d: Skin turns hard as granite against blows.

name: Storm of the End
d: A storm unleashes thunder, lightning, and rain.

name: Honeyed Urging
d: Your words plant an idea that seems entirely reasonable to the listener.

name: Solar Lance
d: A beam of brilliant sunlight blasts out from your hand.

name: Solar Flare
d: A blinding burst of sunlight sears all around you.

name: Cursed Script
d: A deadly glyph waits to strike those who trigger it.

name: Mindlift
d: You move creatures and objects with the power of your mind.

name: Mindlink
d: Your minds link for shared, silent speech.

name: Long Leap
d: You and your allies vanish and reappear far away.

name: Waygate Ring
d: A circle of runes opens a door to a far place.

name: Omen Sign
d: The ground trembles, flames flicker, and your voice booms with the weight of the heavens.

name: Thunder Ring
d: A wave of thunderous force bursts out from you, hurling foes back.

name: Timefreeze
d: Time stops for all but you.

name: Hearth Dome
d: A dome of shimmering force shelters your camp through the night.

name: Gift of Speech
d: A creature understands and speaks every spoken language.

name: Rootway
d: You step through one plant and emerge from another.

name: Treewalk
d: You step into one tree and out of another far away.

name: Perfect Shift
d: A creature or object transforms into anything.

name: Whole Again
d: A creature returns to life whole.

name: Clear Eyes
d: Your eyes see things as they truly are.

name: Foe's Tell
d: You glimpse a foe's next move a heartbeat before it happens.

name: Phantom Helper
d: An invisible, mindless helper appears to fetch, carry, and clean.

name: Leeching Grip
d: Your touch drains life from a foe and feeds it to you.

name: Barbed Jest
d: Your words cut sharper than steel, laced with magic that stings the mind.

name: Fire Rampart
d: A wall of roaring fire rises at your command.

name: Unseen Bulwark
d: An invisible wall of force blocks all who pass.

name: Rime Rampart
d: A wall of ice rises to block your foes.

name: Stone Rampart
d: A wall of stone rises from the ground.

name: Briar Hedge
d: A wall of tangled thorns rises from the ground.

name: Soulbond Ward
d: A bond links you to an ally, sharing their pain to protect them.

name: Gillbreath
d: Creatures breathe underwater as easily as air.

name: Wavewalk
d: Creatures walk across water as though it were solid ground.

name: Sticky Weave
d: Thick, sticky webs fill an area, ensnaring anything caught inside.

name: Dreadweave
d: Nightmare illusions stalk many minds at once.

name: Cloudwalk
d: Creatures turn to cloud and ride the winds.

name: Howling Screen
d: A wall of howling wind deflects arrows and gusts.

name: Heartwish
d: Your deepest wish reshapes reality itself.

name: Homecall
d: You and your allies instantly return to a sacred place.

name: Banish Lies
d: A circle of magic compels honesty from all within it.

name: Grace Bolt
d: Gracewraith only. Evocation cantrip; 1 action; range 60 ft; components V, S. A chain of radiant light lashes out. Make a ranged spell attack (proficiency + INT). On a hit, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage (don't add INT to damage). Beams: 1 at levels 1-4, 2 at 5-10, 3 at 11-16, 4 at 17-30. Each beam is a separate attack roll; aim them at the same target or different ones. Once per turn, when a beam hits a Large or smaller creature, you can pull it up to 5 ft toward you. Counts toward your cantrip limit.

name: Crown of Lies
d: One humanoid you can see makes a wisdom roll or is charmed. Before it moves on each of its turns, it must make one melee attack against a creature other than you that you choose mentally, or it acts normally if no such creature is in reach. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. On each of your turns, you must use your action to keep control, or the spell ends.

name: Make Friends
d: A little glamour makes a stranger warm to you, until the spell fades and they realize it.

name: Darkling Whispers
d: A whisper only your target hears claws at its mind and sends it scrambling away from you.
